scope: Implemented Ace local persistence, diagnostics, attachments, feedback, and explicitly absent telemetry flows. Values and credentials are never included in this registry.

flows.switch: session deletion and follow-up record_history; no global history-disable switch
flows.destination: local SQLite sessions table at Config.db_path (config/config.yaml defaults to crew_data/crew.db)
fields: owner_account_id, session_id, and workspace_id
serialized Message role, user/assistant/tool content, tool-call metadata, timestamps, and optional content parts
derived title, message_count, token_count, and last run status
owner-scoped attachment references that may occur in message content or structured attachments
flows.retention: Rows remain local until explicit session/workspace deletion or the idle-session expiry loop removes an eligible session; no remote retention is used by this flow.
flows.deletion: DELETE /api/session/{session_id} and workspace deletion clear owner-scoped session rows; expire_idle_sessions removes idle top-level sessions. Referenced upload files are separately considered by delete_session_uploads.
flows.redaction: Tool arguments use tool_arguments_for_history; this registry records only field classes, and user-provided message content is treated as potentially sensitive.

flows.switch: application wiring selects SQLiteMemory; no independent runtime disable switch is present
flows.destination: local SQLite memory table at Config.memory_db_path (default crew_data/memory.db)
fields: owner_account_id and stable session_id
latest non-empty user message text
write timestamp
flows.retention: Rows persist in the local memory database until MemoryProvider.delete is called; the current session deletion route has no observed call to that method.
flows.deletion: SQLiteMemory.delete can remove rows for one owner and session, but no session-delete caller is registered here; this is an explicit retention gap rather than an assumed deletion guarantee.
flows.redaction: Only user-role message text is selected; no credentials or secret values are placed in this registry.

flows.switch: security authorization and audit lifecycle; no user-content export switch
flows.destination: owner-scoped security_audit_events and security_audit_archives in Config.db_path, plus the private audit integrity key file
fields: owner, workspace, session, task, request, turn, and actor identity hash
normalized action digest, rule and permission profile identifiers, decision, outcome, and stable error code
policy/build/model provenance and bounded action/resource summaries
flows.retention: Live audit rows older than 30 days are eligible for authenticated archive rotation; archives remain local until separately removed.
flows.deletion: purge_expired rotates an authenticated contiguous prefix into security-audit-archives; ordinary session deletion does not erase security audit history.
flows.redaction: AuditEvent formatting and persistence redact sensitive action, CLI, header, diagnostic, and structured fields before HMAC coverage.

flows.switch: runtime.log_file controls file persistence; the in-process ring buffer remains available to system log routes
flows.destination: optional local log_file plus the process-local RingBufferHandler
fields: timestamp, level, logger name, and owner_account_id
redacted application log message and bounded exception text
flows.retention: The process-local ring is bounded to 2000 entries; a configured log file remains until local operator cleanup.
flows.deletion: DELETE /api/system/logs clears the process-local ring; file deletion is an operator/filesystem action and is not claimed as an API behavior.
flows.redaction: SensitiveLogFilter and redact helpers run before handlers persist messages; owner filtering applies to non-admin log queries.

flows.switch: runtime.llm_trace / Config.llm_trace (default false in Config and config/config.yaml)
flows.destination: local .crew/logs/llm.jsonl, derived from log_file or the configured Crew home
fields: session_id, owner_account_id, model, direction, stream state, and bounded error or milestone metadata
sanitized provider request messages, tool names, response text, tool-call arguments, reasoning, and usage when tracing is enabled
flows.retention: The trace is a local JSONL file with no repository-defined expiry; it is absent when llm_trace is false.
flows.deletion: No dedicated trace-delete route is present; local operator cleanup of llm.jsonl is required.
flows.redaction: _sanitize_llm_trace redacts sensitive keys, browser content, image data, and log-sensitive values before serialization; trace remains opt-in because payload text can still be user-sensitive.

flows.switch: local owner upload is part of attachment handling; wiki.capture_attachments independently controls the optional Wiki copy
flows.destination: owner-scoped local uploads directory, with optional default-Wiki capture
fields: authenticated owner account, original filename, file type, byte size, and content digest for deduplication
uploaded bytes in the private owner uploads store
owner-scoped path reference and attachment metadata passed to the agent
flows.retention: Uploads remain in the owner uploads store until referenced session cleanup; an optional Wiki copy follows the Wiki store lifecycle. No broader automatic retention is claimed.
flows.deletion: Session deletion collects only upload paths resolved under the owner uploads root and unlinks them; path escape, links, non-regular files, and unreferenced files are not deleted by that routine.
flows.redaction: The registry contains no filenames, paths, or bytes from a run. Upload and attachment handling enforces owner roots, regular-file checks, byte/count limits, and bounded atomic writes.

references: upload, deduplication, and optional Wiki capture

flows.switch: valid CREW_FEEDBACK_BASE_URL plus consent authority; ACE_ENTERPRISE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK or CREW_FEEDBACK_DISABLED disables it
flows.destination: configured HTTPS feedback service; local main-process preview, one-time authority, and bounded diagnostic trace
fields: redacted and bounded title and description
bounded image attachment bytes and SHA-256 digests
owner/context/payload digests, status codes, and bounded remote response text
flows.retention: Preview and authority state is in-process and expires; the local feedback trace is bounded. Remote service retention and deletion policy are not specified by this repository.
flows.deletion: Preview/authority cancellation and local trace clearing are implemented; no remote feedback-delete endpoint is implemented or claimed.
flows.redaction: Feedback input, remote response text, URLs, errors, and image metadata pass through bounded redaction; raw attachment buffers are zeroed after preparation/submission.

references: consent, redaction, attachment cleanup, and IPC boundary

flows.switch: absent: no Ace analytics emitter or upload switch is implemented
fields: no analytics payload is emitted by the implemented Ace paths
flows.retention: not applicable because this flow creates no data
flows.deletion: not applicable because this flow creates no data

flows.switch: absent: no Ace OTEL exporter or export switch is implemented
fields: no OTEL span or metric payload is emitted by the implemented Ace paths
flows.retention: not applicable because this flow creates no data
flows.deletion: not applicable because this flow creates no data

flows.switch: absent: no rollout telemetry collector or upload switch is implemented
fields: no rollout telemetry payload is emitted by the implemented Ace paths
flows.retention: not applicable because this flow creates no data
flows.deletion: not applicable because this flow creates no data

references: Ace product-boundary treatment of rollout telemetry
